description.zh: 在这台电脑上运行 AI 模型，断网也能用：“翻译”选“本地模型”就能离线翻译，“按意思找”选“本地模型”就能离线按意思找文件，内容不出本机。可一键下载推荐的模型，也可以导入自己的 .gguf 模型文件（Ollama、LM Studio 下好的都行）。有显卡就用显卡，没有就用 CPU；不用时自动释放内存
description.en: Runs an AI model on this computer, with no network needed: set Translate's service to Local model to translate offline, or Search by meaning's to find files by meaning offline, and nothing leaves this PC. Download a recommended model in one click, or use a .gguf model file of your own (from Ollama or LM Studio too). The GPU when there is one, else the CPU; the memory is freed when idle

notes.zh: “本机接口端口”的说明写明：翻译和按意思找只连默认的 39281，改了端口它们就用不上本地模型。程序没有变化，权限不变。
notes.en: The Local API port's hint now says that Translate and Search by meaning use only the default 39281, so another port leaves them without the local model. The program is unchanged; permissions unchanged.
